title: Create internal dashboards for onboarding telemetry health + funnel metrics
creator: Logan Wright
description:
Background
- Guided onboarding checklist (Console) is shipping behind a feature flag. We need reliable internal visibility into:
  (1) telemetry pipeline health (are we receiving events with expected coverage/latency?)
  (2) onboarding funnel metrics (step completion + time-to-first-success / time-to-production proxies)
- This ticket covers dashboard buildout + documented queries/definitions. It does NOT define the schema (see event schema doc + ENG-23112), but does include “metric semantics” and how we compute them.

Goals
1) Telemetry health dashboard
- Catch instrumentation regressions quickly (missing events, property allowlist issues, dedupe/idempotency bugs, region-specific dropouts).
- Provide SRE-friendly signals + links for triage.

2) Funnel dashboard
- Track completion rates and time-to-complete for each checklist step and overall onboarding.
- Enable breakdowns by cohort/flag variant, SDK language, region, and acquisition channel (where available) to support iteration decisions.

Dashboards to deliver
A) Onboarding Telemetry Health (Grafana)
Primary audience: Console Eng, Telemetry Platform, SRE
Panels (MVP)
- Event volume by name (last 1h / 24h / 7d) with baseline band (previous 7d same hour)
  - onboarding_checklist_viewed
  - onboarding_step_completed
  - onboarding_step_validated
  - onboarding_checklist_reset (admin)
  - onboarding_docs_link_clicked
- Pipeline latency (p50/p95) by stage
  - client emit -> ingestion (gateway)
  - ingestion -> warehouse table available
- Coverage / missingness
  - % of active checklist users with “checklist_viewed” but zero downstream events within 30m
  - % of events failing allowlist / dropped properties (from redaction/allowlist counters)
  - dedupe rate: % events dropped due to duplicate dedupe_key
- Dimensions
  - region
  - environment (prod/staging)
  - app surface (console_web)
  - event_schema_version
- Links
  - runbook: console-checklist-feature-flag-rollout
  - schema: onboarding-telemetry-event-schema-v1

Alerting (tie-in; implementation in ENG-23125 but define thresholds here)
- Missing critical events in any region for >15 minutes (compared to expected baseline)
- Warehouse freshness >30 minutes for onboarding_events table
- Spike in redaction/allowlist drops (>5% of events over 10 min)

B) Onboarding Funnel (Looker/Mode) — metrics for PM/Design/Eng
Primary audience: PM (Marissa/Nikhil), Design (Tessa/Kenji), DevEx
Cohorts
- Default cohort: new orgs created after checklist flag enabled AND exposed to checklist (flag=true).
- Optional comparison cohort: new orgs not exposed (flag=false) for baseline.

Core metrics
- Signup -> API key created (if available via console events; otherwise proxy via “api_key_created” audit event)
- TTFS (time-to-first-success): org_created_at -> first_successful_request_at
- Step funnel conversion (per step)
  - step reached (checklist viewed) -> step validated/completed
  - completion rate by step
  - median/p75 time from org_created_at to step completion
- Drop-off analysis
  - last completed step distribution
  - time stuck in step (orgs that haven’t progressed in 24h)
- Engagement correlation (lightweight)
  - step completion vs D7 usage (requests/token usage bucketed) (note: keep this coarse; no prompt content)

Required breakdowns
- cohort type: new_org / existing_org (if we include existing orgs in beta)
- rollout percent bucket / allowlist vs random
- SDK language (python/typescript/go/unknown) — derived from user_agent or sdk_name property
- region
- entry point (console vs docs vs quickstart UTM where present)

Data sources / tables
- onboarding_events (warehouse) — canonical event log; must include
  - event_name
  - event_timestamp
  - org_id, project_id (where applicable)
  - user_id (optional; hashed/opaque)
  - dedupe_key
  - event_schema_version
  - sdk_name / user_agent (allowlisted)
- request_success_signals (warehouse) — derived from gateway logs/metrics used by “first success” validator
- org_dim / project_dim for created_at timestamps + plan/tier (if allowed)

Definitions (must match PRD language)
- first_successful_request_at: first 2xx response from Hosted API for given project, excluding Console “test connection” calls; must be computed from gateway request logs/metrics with a stable definition.
- first_streaming_session_at: first streamed response where stream opened AND at least one chunk delivered (to reduce false positives from immediate disconnects).
- step_completed vs step_validated
  - completed: user manually marks done OR performs action in Console that marks done
  - validated: server-validated signal (e.g., first_successful_request) observed; should supersede manual completion when both exist

Implementation notes
- For funnel dashboard, prefer a derived “onboarding_step_facts” model table/view that normalizes step IDs and computes per-org first completion timestamps.
  - step_id canonical set must match checklist step contract; do not join on display copy.
  - handle idempotency: use earliest timestamp for completion; keep a count for repeated completions to detect flapping.
- Use event_schema_version to avoid silent breakage during schema migration.
- Privacy constraints
  - No prompt content, no raw request/response bodies.
  - Only allowlisted properties are queryable.
  - Avoid surfacing user identifiers in dashboards; default to org-level aggregations.

Deliverables
- Grafana dashboard: “Onboarding Telemetry Health” (prod + staging folders)
- Looker/Mode report: “Guided Onboarding Funnel v1”
- Short internal doc in ticket description (or linked) describing metric definitions + common pitfalls
- Saved queries / explores with standardized filters for cohort selection

Acceptance criteria
- Health dashboard shows event volume + freshness + redaction/dedupe counters, filterable by region and schema version.
- Funnel dashboard supports step-by-step conversion + time-to-step metrics, with cohort filter and SDK language breakdown.
- Metric definitions reviewed by PM (Marissa/Nikhil) and Telemetry Platform (Logan/Nadia).
- Dashboards validated against at least one beta cohort week (sanity check counts vs raw events).

Open questions
1) Where do we source org_created_at reliably for self-serve signups (auth service vs billing service)?
2) Do we include existing orgs in the primary funnel view during beta (risk skew) or keep separate tabs?
3) Is SDK language classification stable enough from user_agent, or do we need explicit sdk_name property guaranteed by SDKs?

Links
- Event schema: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/observability-standards/onboarding-telemetry-event-schema-v1.json
- Feature flag rollout runbook: sources/confluence/eng-platform/runbooks/console-checklist-feature-flag-rollout.json
- PM requirements: PM-484-onboarding-funnel-metrics-and-dashboards
